request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Aetherfin Koi".

Creative brief
Name: Aetherfin Koi
Collection: Arcane Menagerie. Wild creatures altered by concentrated magic, with crystalline anatomy, runes, echoes, orbiting objects, and unusual projectile behavior.
Core concept: A floating swimmer that paints curved projectile streams through open air.
Body and silhouette: Large rounded fish with long ribbon fins, a forked tail, and a smooth hovering posture.
Signature features: Floating water halo, rune scales, and translucent square-edged fins.
Palette and materials: Cream white, muted coral, deep blue, and pale cyan light.
Movement personality: Serene, flowing, and constantly circling.
Attack concept: Swims along a broad curve and releases evenly spaced water orbs that continue following the same route.
Directional details: A dark rune patch sits behind the right gill.
Avoid: Ordinary pond fish, dragon whiskers, overly transparent fins.
